# PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH] Contents of this Part

## Documents to be verified by a statement of truth

## 22.1

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (1) The following documents must be verified by a statement of truth—

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (a) a statement of case;

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (b) a witness statement;

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (c) an acknowledgement of service in a claim using the Part 8 procedure;

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (d) a certificate of service;

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (e) a contempt application under Part 81; and

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (f) any other document where a rule or practice direction requires.

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (2) Where a statement of case is amended, the amendments must be verified by a statement of truth unless the court orders otherwise.

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (3) If an applicant wishes to rely on matters set out in their application notice as evidence, it must be verified by a statement of truth.

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (4) A statement of truth is a statement that the maker believes the facts stated in the document to which the statement refers are true.

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (5) If a party has a litigation friend, the statement of truth in a statement of case or an application notice is a statement that the litigation friend believes the facts stated in it are true.

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (6) The statement of truth must be signed by –

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (a) in the case of a statement of case, a notice of objections to an account being taken by the court or an application –

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (i) the party or litigation friend; or

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (ii) the legal representative on behalf of the party or litigation friend; and

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (b) in the case of a witness statement, the maker of the statement.

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (7) A statement of truth which is not contained in the document which it verifies, must clearly identify that document.

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (8) A statement of truth in a statement of case may be made by –

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (a) a person who is not a party; or

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (b) by two parties jointly,

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] where this is permitted by a relevant practice direction.

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (9) Where a document containing a statement of truth is to be signed by a person who is unable to read or sign the document other than by reason of language alone—

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (a) it must contain a certificate made by an authorised person (who is able to administer oaths and take affidavits but need not be independent of the parties or their representatives); and

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (b) the authorised person must certify that—

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (i) the document has been read to the person approving it;

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (ii) that person appeared to understand it and approved its content as accurate;

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (iii) the declaration of truth has been read to that person;

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (iv) that person appeared to understand the declaration and the consequences of making a false declaration; and

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.1] (v) that person signed or made their mark in the presence of the authorised person.

## Failure to verify a statement of case

## 22.2

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.2] (1) If a party fails to verify their statement of case by a statement of truth –

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.2] (a) the statement of case shall remain effective unless struck out; but

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.2] (b) the party may not rely on the statement of case as evidence of any of the matters set out in it.

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.2] (2) The court may strike out (GL) a statement of case which is not verified by a statement of truth.

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.2] (3) Any party may apply for an order under paragraph (2).

## Failure to verify a witness statement

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > Failure to verify a witness statement] 22.3 If the maker of a witness statement fails to verify it by a statement of truth the court may direct that it shall not be admissible as evidence.

## Power of the court to require a document to be verified

## 22.4

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.4] (1) The court may order a person who has failed to do so in accordance with rule 22.1 to verify the document.

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.4] (2) Any party may apply for an order under paragraph (1).

[PART 22 – STATEMENTS OF TRUTH > 22.4] (Rule 32.14 states that verifying a statement of case containing a false statement without an honest belief in its truth may result in proceedings for contempt of court.)
